meta.title: Test innovations
meta.description: Sign up to test new social solutions, or rate the ones you know.

page.title: Test innovations
page.lead: New social solutions need to be tried out in real life. Sign up to test one, or rate a solution you already know — your opinion goes to the ROPS team.
page.notOpen: This solution has no open call for testers right now. Sign up anyway — the ROPS team will get in touch when testing starts.

notFound.title: We couldn’t find this solution
notFound.body: The address may be incomplete. Please choose a solution from the list.

choose.heading: What would you like to do?
choose.signUpHint: Sign up — you’ll try the solution in practice and tell us what works.
choose.rateHint: Do you know it? Give it a score from 1 to 5 and tell us what to improve.
choose.card: Read the full description in the library

open.heading: Solutions looking for testers
open.body: ROPS has opened testing for these solutions. Sign up — the team will get in touch with dates and details.
open.emptyTitle: No solution is open for testing right now
open.emptyBody: Below are candidates for testing — you can sign up to test them or rate them.

candidates.heading: Candidates for testing
candidates.note: ROPS has chosen these solutions for wider use, but they have no open call for testers right now. You can sign up to test them or rate them — the ROPS team will get in touch when testing starts.

none.title: No solutions to test
none.body: Have a look in the library — you can rate any solution from its page.

forms.restored: We restored the answers saved on this device (without your contact details).

where.title: Where do you live or work?

contact.title: How should we contact you?
